exam_scheme.note: Telangana State Engineering Common Entrance Test (TG ECET) is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by Osmania University on behalf of the Telangana Council of Higher Education (TGCHE) for Diploma holders in Engineering/Technology/Pharmacy and B.Sc. (Mathematics) degree holders for lateral entry admission into the 2nd year regular B.E. / B.Tech. and B.Pharmacy courses in AICTE/PCI approved institutions. For Engineering Diploma candidates, the test consists of 200 objective multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks of 180 minutes (3 hours) duration: Mathematics (50 marks), Physics (25 marks), Chemistry (25 marks), and the relevant Engineering paper (100 marks). Each question carries 1 mark with no negative marking. The qualifying mark is 25% of the aggregate marks (50 out of 200) for General and BC candidates; no minimum qualifying mark is prescribed for SC and ST candidates.
